questions.prompt: Name a year (CE) that is famous in Islamic history.

answers.explanation: The Hijrah — year 1 of the Islamic calendar.
The Year of the Elephant, when the Prophet ﷺ was born.
The death of the Prophet ﷺ and the Farewell Hajj.
The abolition of the Ottoman caliphate.
The Battles of Yarmuk and al-Qadisiyyah.
The death of 'Ali and start of the Umayyads.

questions.prompt: Name something from the story of the Najashi, the king of Abyssinia.

answers.explanation: "A king in whose land no one is wronged."
When Ja'far recited it, he wept until his beard was wet.
He believed in the Prophet ﷺ.
The Prophet ﷺ prayed janazah for him from Madinah.

answers.canonical: Refused to hand them to Quraysh
answers.explanation: 'Amr ibn al-'As came with gifts to bring them back.

answers.canonical: Married Umm Habibah to the Prophet ﷺ
answers.explanation: He conducted the marriage by proxy and paid her dowry.

answers.canonical: "Between your religion and ours is no more than this line"
answers.explanation: Drawing a line on the ground after hearing about 'Isa.

answers.canonical: Received a letter from the Prophet ﷺ
Sent gifts to the Prophet ﷺ

questions.prompt: Name a manner of giving or returning salam taught in the Hadith.

answers.canonical: Reply with something better or the same
answers.explanation: "When you are greeted, greet with better or return it."

answers.canonical: The walker greets the one sitting
Greet those you know and don't know
variants: Those you know and do not know
answers.explanation: "…and greet those you know and those you do not."
"When you enter houses, greet one another."

answers.canonical: The first to greet is closest to Allah
answers.explanation: "The closest people to Allah are those who start the greeting."

answers.canonical: Greeting when leaving a gathering too
answers.explanation: "…the first is not more deserving than the last."
Ten for "as-salamu 'alaykum", twenty with "wa rahmatullah", thirty with "wa barakatuh".

questions.prompt: Name an Arabic word for a season or kind of weather.

answers.explanation: Spring — also the name of two months.

answers.explanation: "That is the one who drives away the orphan."

bonus.prompt: Name an Arabic word that comes from the root k-b-r (greatness).

answers.explanation: Big, great — al-Kabir, a name of Allah.

answers.canonical: Others who have not yet joined
answers.explanation: "…and others of them who have not yet joined them."
